question: How quickly is supreme attainment reached in these teachings compared with other methods?
premises: Supreme attainment can arise quickly in our teachings.
In some cases attainment follows the methodical sequence of tattva-series yoga.
That methodical sequence may take a long time.
inference: Our teachings can yield supreme attainment quickly, whereas some tattva-series methods yield it only after a long time.
uncertainties: The contrast is compressed; the verse implies but does not fully spell out the opposing system.
plain_english: In our teachings supreme attainment comes quickly indeed; in some cases, by contrast, it comes only after a long time through the methodical sequence of yoga based on the series of tattvas.
